review_note: Reviewed all 124 chronological originals and enlarged aiming, grip and recoil details. The launcher raises, levels into aim, kicks back through a pronounced torso/arm recoil, then returns to ready. Excluded originals 48-51 with an unwanted flash and stray effect fragments, retaining a sharp 47-to-52 release transition and the clean recoil/recovery. Selected 26 originals over 1.43 seconds; release contact at original 52, selected index 14. The runtime supplies the projectile separately. No effect pixels in the selection, reversed frames, duplicate padding or painted repair.
